title: Volcanoes of Japan (streak)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Japan, one after another. Three markers too far from the place end the run, so aim with care. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Onikōbe Caldera
rounds.fact: Onikōbe Caldera is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 769 m in the source data. The data places it in Japan.

rounds.name: Lake Towada
